what_this_is: A single-method re-measurement of the GENUINE bayesprism R package on the anatomic cohort, after it fell back to the Python reimplementation in the confirmatory run. Reported alongside that run, never substituted into it.

gene_space.strategy: the leaderboard's own gene space, read from the run artefact

3_held_out_donors.note: the reference and the cell export carry TRAINING donors only, as run_all stage 4 does, so none of the 22 held-out donors' cells reach the method

7_normalisation_and_scale.per_cell_normalisation: 1e6 across the restricted gene set, before profile averaging; raw totals captured first as cell_size
7_normalisation_and_scale.bulk_scaling: CPM over the 657-gene space (columns sum to 1e6)

WHAT_HAPPENED: NOT a BayesPrism result. This run was given a 14,400 s budget deliberately, and an EXTERNAL WATCHDOG script -- written earlier in the same session to enforce the PIPELINE's 2,700 s cap -- killed it at 2,702 s with SIGKILL. The watchdog silently overrode a deliberate scientific choice about how long the genuine package may run. It also wrote this file over a valid 2026-09-14 measurement (acs 0.8154), which has been restored from backup. Kept as the record of the interference, not as a measurement.
